The mention of stars and light can evoke the sensation of hope, guidance, and the beauty of God's creation. This name can be seen as a reminder of the guidance of stars in navigation before the advent of modern technology, and the constellations can be traced back to several Islamic traditions and legends.

As a spiritual significance, it implies that the individual carrying this name has the potential to illuminate, uplift, and inspire those around them. The name Ni'sha is a reminder of the light of Allah within each person, encouraging them to seek their inner light and to share it with others. It serves as a reminder to be a source of kindness, love, and wisdom, and to manifest the divine qualities of compassion and grace in everyday life.
